target.statement: RIF achieves AUC 0.99 on the two-spherical-Gaussian synthetic dataset (2000 normal points, 6 anomalies), vs iForest 0.66 and EIF 0.83
target.dataset: synthetic 2D two spherical Gaussians (centers (0.8,0.2) and (0.2,0.8), sigma 0.06, 2000 points + 6 anomalies)

compute.basis: Synthetic data is generated from the paper's description; RIF is a simple modification of iForest (random QR rotation per tree, 100 trees, sample 256) that must be reimplemented from the pseudocode, and the run itself is seconds on CPU.

blockers: No code released; RIF, iForest and EIF must all be reimplemented from the paper text
Exact anomaly point placement and random seeds are not fully specified, so the exact AUC values (0.99/0.66/0.83) may not be bit-reproducible
title: Detecting Anomalies Using Rotated Isolation Forest
